lina (devex): quick ping — Python sampleapp started throwing a mysterious 500 during embed -> rerank integration tests. only on CI, flaky locally.
omar (sdk): can you paste the failing log?
harry (sampleapp): here you go (from pytest run):
```
E       AssertionError: payload validation failed
E       Details: embeddings[2] length mismatch. expected 1536 got 1535
E       Request body: {\n  \"queries\": [...],\n  \"embeddings\": [[...], [...], [0.0, ... 1535 items ...]]\n}
```
lina (devex): interesting — that one is missing one, not +1. saw another run with +1 earlier. both smells like mutation during retry.
marta (eng-ml): pattern I've seen: batching helper has two codepaths: pad_right for singletons and reserve+append for batches. if a retry reuses the same underlying buffer and the pad path runs, you can end up with variable length depending on timing.
omar (sdk): ah ok. do we have an auth refresh in the flow? token-bot: automatic: access token expired -> refresh kicked in (simulated).
harry (sampleapp): yes, CI injects a short-lived token to test refresh. when refresh and batch retry collide, we sometimes double-pad or truncate.
lina (devex): repro steps?
marta (eng-ml): 1) run sampleapp smoke with REDWOOD_TOKEN_TTL=1s, 2) push a 4-item batch, 3) force a 401 on first embed; token refresh requeues batch while pad_right is still running => race.
omar (sdk): plan: 1) make batching helper immutable on enqueue (copy buf), 2) add verify_embeddings(vecs, expected_dim) early in SDK that raises before sending, 3) improve dev error message to say "vector length mismatch: expected X, got Y — check batching helpers and retries".
lina (devex): nice. can we also surface a dev-mode env var that errors fast? `REDWOOD_VEC_STRICT=1` maybe.
harry (sampleapp): I'll add an assert in the sampleapp queue consumer for now. quick patch: `assert len(v)==MODEL_DIMS, f"vec dim mismatch: {len(v)} != {MODEL_DIMS}"`
omar (sdk): I'll prepare a tiny release v0.9.4 with the immutability change + a unit test that simulates concurrent pad+retry. will also add a sanitization hook that trims/validates but only in permissive mode.
marta (eng-ml): also fix rerank response handling. one of our services returns `{ items: null }` during a scoring exception; SDK should validate that `items` is an array of numbers and return a clear error if not.
lina (devex): can we add a short note to onboarding docs: "If your app uses batching helpers, enable REDWOOD_VEC_STRICT during onboarding to catch buffer mutation issues early."
harry (sampleapp): will update README and add migration snippet for teams using the old batching helper.
token-bot: scheduled job: run sdk/v0.9.4-canary tests
omar (sdk): PR soon. ping @omar if you see other tensor-length flakes. thanks folks — this was driving a confusing CI signal. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
lina (devex): leaving this thread open for postmortem notes and to track the docs update.
